assessments.reasoning: N3220 §6.2.4 paragraph 4 begins on printed page 37 (PDF page 50) by assigning thread storage duration to the object whose identifier is declared using thread_local. The continuation on printed page 38 (PDF page 51) gives each thread a distinct object and makes evaluation by name refer to the evaluating thread's object. The exact bytes were retrieved from WG14's document directory and the PDF identifies itself as working draft N3220. The independently computed SHA-256 equals the registered digest.

challenge.method: Read the whole paragraph across the page break and challenge the proposition with the paragraph's separate case for indirect access from another thread.
challenge.results: The per-thread object rule applies directly. The same paragraph makes the result of indirect access from a different thread implementation-defined, so the candidate's limitation preserves that separate question.

limitations: This is the storage-duration and per-thread association rule in N3220. The indirect cross-thread case depends on the implementation under the draft.
